text:
Nora: Kicking off DynamoPay POC thread — they want streaming SDK (Python first), function/tool-call (payment_normalizer), structured JSON output for downstream ETL, SAML SSO, KMS for PCI-like data, and a reserved capacity estimate. Who can take SDK + perf?
Diego: I can own SDK samples and the curl fallback. Will prioritize Python then Node.
Sam K: Perf target p50 < 180ms at steady 60 rps, with spikes up to 250. We'll bench with rw-med-quant and a 2x batcher.
Priya S: I'll complete the security questionnaire (encryption/KMS flow, key separation, SOC2). Need an annotated KMS diagram to attach to Legal.
PresalesBot: POC ticket POC-5234 created. Owners: Nora, Diego. Due: 2026-05-12.
Nora: Acceptance criteria for the customer: 1) streaming demo with payment_normalizer tool returns validated JSON matching their schema; 2) perf: p50 < 180ms at 60 rps; 3) end-to-end SAML SSO; 4) contract docs: DPA signed + SOC2 available. Proposed demo slot: Thu 11am PT.
Diego: Uploaded samples + small validator script to the shared drive (tools/validators). Quick curl example for infra team:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-med-quant","stream":true,"input":"..."}'
```
Sam K: Running perf harness now; will post p50/p95 and resource utilization to drive in ~30m.
Nora: Great — Priya, please ping when security QA is attached and I'll loop Legal + Customer Success. Thanks team :thumbsup:
